name: Winter's Clutch
text:
Gleaming flakes of chilling snow fall in a 10-foot burst within 60 feet. Each creature in the area takes floor((@actor.level -1/2)+2)d4 cold damage with a basic Reflex save save against your class DC. The ground in the area is covered in a snow drift, which is difficult terrain. Each square of the drift lasts until it melts, either naturally or until fire damage is dealt in that square.

---

Level (+2) The damage increases by 1d4.
